47156473:  ;
 ;This routine is called to determine whether the patient record
 ;contains prohibited data values. It checks for the existence of
 ;entries in the DISABILITY CONDITION multiple of the patient
 ;record, which could indicate that the prohibition logic needs
 ;to be applied.
 ;
b2012d6c: ;Call the DE setup code and then jump to the BEGIN label
6b700050: ;Set up variables for FileMan call to check DISABILITY CONDITION multiple
28363088: ;If there is data in the 0 node, extract the DISABILITY CONDITION value
de99f8af: ;Clean up and quit
70a71b84: Print prompt and set up for input reader.
990933c5: Return without doing anything.
80a83ea2: If in loop, write question and position cursor.
49fc2217: If long read and not a full boolean, display right side of prompt if needed.
6d5cd17e: If no entry is required and boolean, display 'No Editing' message.
65ec89a2: Read user's input or timeout.
5845b4dd: Exit subroutine.
9fc449cd: Increment the data vector (DQ) by 1.
b814c20e: Branch to the line specified by the value of DQ.
06b93e60: If the data error (DE) array element specified by DQ is defined, go to the 'PR' line label; otherwise, execute the 'W' and 'TR' subroutines.

ef30163f: If X is empty, and DV does not contain 'R', go to 'A'; if X is empty and DV contains a value, go to 'X'; if X is empty and the internal value (D) is greater than 0, go to 'A'; otherwise, go to 'X'.
4dcc47f6: If X starts with a question mark, go to 'QS'; if X starts with an up-arrow, execute the 'D' subroutine and then go to the routine ^DIE17.
4de56f51: If X is an '@', execute the 'D' subroutine and then go to the line label 'Z^DIE2'.

6059a981: If X is a space, DV contains 'd', DV does not contain 'P', and the 'DIE' array for the current user (DUZ) and file label (DLB) is defined, set X to the value of ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB). If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write '  ' followed by the value of X.
26fc1ec8: ;If a value matches, validate it by calling the input transform in ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1)
4a8b7652: ;If there are multiple selections possible, loop through them and call validation code
22c2d05e: ;Write out the selected value and reset X ready for the next loop
89e8c63d: ; If X is negative, do not continue with DIE execution.
3f6847fc: ; If the data value is not numeric, do not continue with validation.
eaf8f9e1: ; Strip off leading zeros and trailing decimal zeros.
a23b425b: ; Execute the Input Transform and kill the Y-stack.
fa9fa75d: ; If X is not undefined, store it in the global array and trigger auditing.
14eee525: ;If required data is present, branch to another section of the code.
4d43d09f: ;Set a default value for X indicating an invalid entry.
d9c91de2: ;Store the current value of X, perform some data manipulation, and then branch to another section of the code.
9c54829b: ;Store various field properties in the DQ array, including the computed transform code.
ef6cb3b3: ;If the data element is not defined, perform some additional processing. Otherwise, branch to different sections of the code based on the value of X and other conditions.
318447a7: ;Set various variables based on the current field's properties, and potentially execute additional code if it's defined for the current field.

59ecf076: This code is executed when the input string starts with 'P', and it checks if the input file exists. If it does, it retrieves the global root and the data global name from the 0 node of the file, and then checks if the subfile specified by Y exists. If it does, it retrieves the field name and the packaged data global name. Finally, it goes to the label R.

0d00035f: This code is executed when the input string starts with 'V', and it checks if the input value (Y) contains a semicolon and parentheses, and if the global specified by the value exists. If it does, it retrieves the global root and the data global name from the 0 node of the global. It then checks if the subfile specified by Y exists, and if it does, it retrieves the field name and the packaged data global name. Finally, it goes to the label R.

54ed1ebb: This code is executed when the input string starts with 'D' or 'S'. If it starts with 'D', it executes the ^DD("DD") routine. If it starts with 'S', it extracts a portion of the input string (X) and assigns it to Y, if it is not empty.

d8c5ea55: If DE(DQ) is not defined, quit. If DE(DQ) is defined, but the variable DV does not contain any value (i.e., DV is null) or if DC is less than 2, go to label A. Otherwise, go to label N^DIE17.
0a0f303f: If the value of DV does not contain the string 'I' or '#', go to label RD.
cac2b9b3: Execute the routine DIE0 at the label E. If X is defined after executing DIE0, go to label RD. Otherwise, go to label PR.
b8643432: Set the variable DNM to 'DGJXA6' and DQ to 1.

0250187c: If the value of the array DG is greater than 9, execute the routine DIE17 at the label F and set DE. Set DQ to 1, DW to '0;9', DV to 'RP200'', DU to an empty string, DLB to 'PRIMARY PHYSICIAN', and DIFLD to .09.
4d64599e: Set the value of DU to 'VA(200,'.
ba24a54c: Set the value of X to the value of DGJT1PH.
8323f27d: Set the value of Y to the value of X.

0c12c32c: Set the value of X to the value of Y. Set the value of DB(DQ) to 1. If X is null, go to label N^DIE17 if DV is null, or go to label A if DV is not null. If DE(DQ) is defined and DV contains 'I' or '#', execute the routine DIE0 at the label E. If X is not defined after executing DIE0, go to label A.
64b6dee5: If X is not null, go to label Z. Otherwise, go to label RD.
717d9da4: Quit.
498f8aa2: If the value of the array DG is greater than 9, execute the routine DIE17 at the label F. Go to label ^DGJXA7.
